path.description: Exact originating path of the best substantive convertible-loan term sheet candidate, or null when none can be identified.

document_match.description: How strongly the selected document substantively matches a convertible-loan term sheet. Use None only with a null path.

concerns.description: Material caveats about document selection, such as a missing or ambiguous term-sheet date, version marker or draft status, an unsigned or partly signed signature block, incompleteness, or doubt whether this is the latest draft.

paths_for_alternative_candidates.description: Exact originating paths of plausible alternative candidates, ordered from most to least likely.

selection_reason.description: Concise explanation of the substantive match and why this candidate was preferred over alternatives.
